title: WsFrame and ClientConfig missing PartialEq
description: WsFrame derives Debug but not PartialEq, preventing == comparisons in tests or application logic. ClientConfig derives Debug+Clone but not PartialEq, so callers cannot compare two configs in tests or configuration-reload code. WsFrame contains StateChange (also missing PartialEq) and jmap_types::JmapResponse — if JmapResponse derives PartialEq, WsFrame could too. The workspace pattern derives PartialEq on all value types.
